***Open to support people, with and without a conference ticket***

Writing a book may be a solo act, but building a sustainable author career takes a team. In this panel, spouses, parents, and partners of successful authors pull back the curtain on the invisible support systems that make the creative life possible. From managing logistics to protecting creative time, discover practical ways loved ones can transition from supportive cheerleaders to strategic partners. Come away with honest perspectives and practical ways to clarify roles and build an author home team that helps both the writer and the people who love them thrive.

1. Identify practical ways loved ones can support the business
2. Learn how to set boundaries so the "help" doesn't become a source of stress.
3. Discover how to align family support with the author's long-term goals.

sessions.sessionTitle: How to Plan, Write, and Promote a Profitable Series
sessions.description:
Most successful author careers are built on series, but many writers publish book one without a long-term strategy.

In this practical workshop, million-copy bestselling indie author Sarra Cannon shares a clear framework for designing, writing, and promoting a series that keeps readers coming back. Drawing from experience writing multiple series across her career, she breaks down the different types of series and how to structure story arcs, keep from burning out, and release books in a way that builds readership instead of restarting with every launch.

Attendees will leave with a simple roadmap for turning their books into a lasting career.

sessions.sessionTitle: Press Play on your Book: How ElevenLabs v4 is Redefining AI Audio for Authors

You wrote the book. Now it's time to hear it. ElevenLabs v4 voice model is the biggest leap in AI narration yet, with extraordinary emotion and delivery, dialogue that sounds like a real conversation, and characters who whisper, laugh, hesitate, and even break.
In this lively, demo-packed session, audiobook producer, and ElevenLabs ambassador, Simon Patrick, shows you how to direct performances that make listeners forget they're hearing AI at all.  

Using live demonstrations, you'll hear how v4 handles the things that once gave AI narration away: rapid exchanges between characters, emotional turning points, tension, humor, and quiet moments of grief. You'll learn how to direct a performance rather than simply generate one, shaping delivery scene by scene so your audiobook feels as alive as the book in your reader's head.

We'll put it all to work inside the dedicated audiobook workflow for authors before following your finished book through to distribution on the major platforms, and specifically ElevenReader, where listeners can discover it and you can start earning.

 AI audiobook narration has just grown up. Press play on your book, and hear it the way you always imagined.

sessions.sessionTitle: From First Sale to Six Figures: How Direct Sales Can Grow Your Author Career
sessions.description:
Direct sales have specific strategies that work. In this session, Greg Keogh will break down the tactics behind successful direct sales and use real-world examples to show how authors can build toward a six-figure business.

As Co-Founder of Curios, Greg sees firsthand what is working, what is not, and which strategies are selling books every day. He will share the playbook behind successful direct-selling authors, including how to create offers that convert, increase the value of each customer, and grow your customer base by getting other people to promote your books.

This session is designed to be practical. You will see real examples, learn which tactics are worth focusing on at different stages of your career, and leave with actionable ideas you can put to work immediately.

The goal is to stop relying on luck and start building a repeatable direct sales strategy that can grow with you from your first sale to six figures.

sessions.sessionTitle: Crowdfunding Panel
sessions.description: Crowdfunding can be more than a way to raise money. It can help you build an audience, test an idea, and turn readers into invested supporters. This panel will dig into the realities of crowdfunding for authors and explore some of the options.

sessions.sessionTitle: Why You Most Likely Won't Be A 7-Figure Author: And Why That's Okay
sessions.description:
THIS ONE MIGHT ALSO BE TITLED SOMETHING LESS "OFFENSIVE" SUCH AS SOMETHING LIKE: "The 25-Year Overnight Success: Reframing Author Career Timelines and Definitions of Success"

The stories we celebrate as sudden successes almost universally involve decades of invisible effort—yet the self-publishing industry continues to sell the myth of rapid discovery, and the fact that anyone can do it.

After all "I did it, so can you!" is such an enticing lie that we all fall prey to.

But what are the realistic chances of getting to a six and seven-figure income as an author when it's clear through numerous industry statistics that most books published selling fewer than a few thousand copies and most authors earning no more than between $2,000 to $5,000 annually.

Andy Weir spent twenty-five years writing before THE MARTIAN landed him a seven-figure film deal. Hugh Howey wrote and published for years in relative obscurity before WOOL caught fire. 

This session confronts the uncomfortable mathematics of author careers head-on. Not to discourage, but to liberate. When authors understand what realistic timelines and income expectations actually look like, they can stop measuring themselves against lottery winners and start building sustainable creative lives.

We'll examine the data on author earnings—including why six-figure incomes remain statistically rare and seven-figure incomes rarer still—and explore what the authors who do build lasting careers have in common. Spoiler: it's rarely a single breakout book. It's almost always a long accumulation of work, learning, and reader relationships built over years.

Whether you're pursuing traditional publishing, self-publishing, or a hybrid path, you're walking through a different door into the same room. Both paths demand the same fundamental qualities: patience, persistence, continuous improvement, and the ability to find meaning in the work itself rather than solely in external validation.

This talk offers a realistic framework for thinking about your author career in decades rather than launches—and why that reframe might be the most important mindset shift you ever make.

Your assistant gets up before you do.

You've cloned yourself and taught the clone how your business runs. Then you went back to writing, which is the only part of this you ever wanted to do.

In this workshop I’ll take you from running ad hoc automations to a comprehensive system. One that knows how you work and doesn't chat about it — it does what you ask, efficiently and securely. Author Nation has brought you best-practice information, expert insight and the latest publishing trends. It’s super valuable—and it’s a lot. Now use the proven, guided processes of Indie Author Lab to step back, identify what's most relevant for you, and prioritise the most valuable things you can do, in the next few weeks. sessions.sessionTitle: Marketing to Market Workshop

This session is about building an incomparable marketing system unique to your business. This is an advanced session
